short: The most powerful nobleman in England, known as the 'Kingmaker' for his role in deposing two kings.
full:
Born on 22 November 1428, Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, leveraged vast inherited wealth and military acumen to become the dominant political figure of his era. He was instrumental in deposing Henry VI and placing Edward IV on the throne in 1461.

When his relationship with Edward broke down over foreign policy and royal favouritism, Warwick orchestrated a startling rebellion that briefly restored Henry VI to power in 1470. He was defeated and killed by Edward IV's returning forces at the Battle of Barnet on 14 April 1471, permanently breaking Neville power.
